== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Find the skree harpy nests on the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] and destroy the skree hatchlings. You have destroyed [0...26] of 26 hatchlings so far.
* See Mofuun for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* [[Battle Commendation]]

== Walkthrough ==
Simply head southwest from [[Champion's Dawn]] towards the shrine outside [[Beknur Harbor]]. Before you get to the shrine, you will encounter 26 hatchlings to kill. For every 6 or so hatchlings that you kill, a higher level Harpy Mother will spawn, so be careful not to be overrun by harpies.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
'''Mofuun'''
:''"I'm glad you're here, <[[character]] name>. I've got a problem that no one but a Sunspear can solve! I am busy creating some of the finest monuments the world has ever seen, but a dark stain hangs over my head. Those gods-be-cursed skree harpies perch on my monuments and then... they deface them! It's horrible. I stay up nights worrying about it. Harpy hatchling season has begun and I fear the devastation a new batch of skree harpies will wreak. I would be eternally grateful if you could find the harpy nests and destroy the skree hatchlings before they become full-grown, monument-defacing monsters."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = We can't have our monuments defaced, now can we?
|decline = I think the harpies gives the monuments a nice...um..."weathered" look.
|ask = Find those blasted harpy nests on the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] and destroy all the skree hatchlings before they grow up and ruin my monuments! }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
'''Mofuun'''
:''"So my monuments will be safe in the future? Thank you, friend. You could give me no greater gift in this world. I'm sorry I can offer you only this humble reward for your services. May the flame of the Sunspears burn eternally as a light of hope to all the peoples of Elona! Thank you again."''

==Notes==
*While a [[Skree Battle]] [[bounty]] would be handy considering the number of Skree encountered during this quest, the Sunspear Scouts that provide this bounty are located on the far side of the quarry.
